android_mechanism: Re-download/re-import performed without checking whether the data is already up to date; fix checks first and skips
bug_description: Opening the dataset sync page unconditionally re-downloads the full classic-poem dataset JSON and re-runs the bulk import, even when the (static, versioned) dataset is already fully imported. Every re-import re-attempts thousands of inserts that all conflict with existing rows (id primary key), wasting network transfer, parsing, and database work on each visit.
fix_summary: Before importing, a single COUNT query checks whether the dataset is already present and skips the download/import entirely when the table is populated.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Wall time of the case action, measured in the app.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed re-downloads the whole dataset and re-attempts all inserts (visible network transfer + DB activity); fixed performs one COUNT and no transfer. unfixed network bytes >> fixed (fixed = 0).

reproduction: git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_sync_page_reimport/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/jingmo checkout case/jingmo_sync_page_reimport/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
